_meta.source_deck: Template—2026 NEW Attentive Company Deck Template.pptx
_meta.units: inches; max_chars are per-line-unit caps from designer placeholder hints where available, else computed from box width / chars_per_inch in fit_text.CPI_TABLE
_meta.note: Geometry x/y/w/h traces to the cited canonical exemplar slide. Values that could not be derived are explicitly marked rather than guessed.

section_divider.purpose: Open a section. Big title + one supporting line on a colored canvas.

agenda.purpose: Agenda / table of contents previewing deck structure. Layout chosen by section count via templates.agenda_slide_for(): 3->24, 4->25, 5->26, 6->27, 7-10->28.

variants.24: 3-column TOC: serif heading + 3 columns, each a colored accent bar + serif Section label + Inter content list
variants.27: 6-section progress list: yellow 'A' panel left + serif vertical list right (active highlighted)
variants.28: 7-10 numbered list: 'Agenda' label + serif number + serif section name

bar.note: colored accent divider above each section column (24-26)

content_with_card.purpose: Workhorse content slide: topic + 4-line header + arrow bullets, with a cream card or image panel on the right.
designer_hints: header = four line header, roughly 110 characters

split_image.purpose: Editorial split: left header + body paragraph, large right-side rounded image.

stat_trio.purpose: Up to three stat/quote callout cards in a row (serif data point + attribution).

testimonial.purpose: Canonical testimonial / quote slide (slides 49-58). Full-page serif quote; with-image variants add a circular headshot. Selected by image availability via decider; color one of cream/yellow/green/blue/orange.

variants.49-53: no image: full-page quote + attribution bottom-left (cream/yellow/green/blue/orange)
variants.54-58: with image: circular headshot top-left + attribution below + quote on the right (same five colors)

comparison_table.purpose: Dense comparison / metrics table. Header row dark, body rows cream-banded.

card_grid.purpose: 3 or 4 equal cards, each an icon dot + title + short body. Areas of focus, pillars, problems. Composed from the deck's card components (slides 9-10); cream or dark (dark=True) card modes.

title_slide.purpose: First slide of a deck. Seven canonical variants selected by title/subtitle length via decider.select_title_template(). Title is Libre Baskerville serif.

section_breaker.purpose: Transition slide between major deck sections. Three layout families x four accent colors. Title is Libre Baskerville serif 30pt, centered. Selected by decider.select_section_breaker() (no count rule — by length/tone/flow; color rotates across sections).

variants.solid: slides 30-33: full-bleed accent color + centered title
variants.photo: slides 34-43: accent color + large centered circular photo + title over it
variants.panel: slides 44-47: cream canvas + left colored 'A' panel + right-side title

statement.purpose: Content section: a single high-impact statement / transition thought. 38pt Libre Baskerville, optional italic emphasis word, optional full-bleed photo background (61-62).

title_prose.purpose: Content section: narrative explanation — topic + title + a prose intro top-right, with a large supporting image/visual area below.

caption_grid.purpose: Content section: visual/caption-led — 3 or 4 images across, each with a short caption below. Screenshots, examples, logos.

end_slide.purpose: Closing slide. EVERY deck must end with exactly one (generate_deck/decider auto-appends if absent; never multiple unless requested). Four variants = background x optional 'Thank you!'. Selection may be random; seedable for determinism.

variants.128: yellow + tonal A + wordmark (no closing text)

wordmark.note: big attentive wordmark across the bottom; replace with brand asset for fidelity

demo_slide.purpose: Product demo: show a workflow, platform screen, or step-by-step example. Three templates by demo format, selected via decider / style='auto'. Place screenshots into the existing frames; if none, the template's placeholder treatment is used.

variants.speaker: slide 122 (dark): intro card — circular headshot + Name (Inter SemiBold 26pt, yellow) + Company/Title (14pt) + Logo (Libre Baskerville 18pt).
variants.moment: slide 123 (dark): annotated product moment — 'Product demo' pill + headshot + headline (24pt yellow) + subhead (18pt) + body (10pt) + screenshots.
variants.workflow: slide 124 (light): before/after — pill + title + 2-4 screenshot frames with arrow connectors + side annotations + optional gap label ('A few days later…').

case_study.purpose: Customer/brand case study: context, challenge, solution, results, proof. Three templates by story density, selected via decider.select_case_study() / style='auto'. Preserves names, quotes, and metrics; reports rather than dropping proof.

variants.stats: slide 118: title + optional quote/screenshots + 3 stat blocks (Libre Baskerville 38pt + yellow pills). Richest, results-led.
variants.narrative: slide 119: eyebrow + title (24pt) + long body (~780 chars) + image card right + quote card bottom-left.
variants.text: slide 120: serif title (22.5pt) + 2 paragraphs (story + outcome) + up to 2 yellow stat pills + right image/card.

fallback.purpose: SECONDARY / fallback canonical templates. Use only when the primary content slides (60-89) cannot hold the amount or format of content. Duplicate the selected physical slide and validate its exact capacity rather than forcing overflow.

groups.131-148: extended bullet & proof layouts (2/3/4-line headers x 4-6 bullets, + optional subhead/stats/metric/proof-cards/QX-badges/sequence)
groups.149-158: structured alternatives: 3 neg/pos point cards, 3 detail/example columns, 4 areas, 4 role cards, 4 problem cards, binary + long comparison tables, 6 areas
groups.159-164: timelines: 5-phase, 4-phase, 2-workstream, swimlane, 9 story blocks, 9 important-thing blocks

fallback.selection: by structure first, then character count. Header height by line count: 2-line 0.67, 3-line 1.06, 4-line 1.40. Bullets 75-85 chars, Inter 10pt. Match the placeholder character density; if it still doesn't fit, split across slides or compress — never silently drop bullets/rows/columns/stats/phases/items.

dataviz.purpose: Data-visualization section. Charts are shape-based; the canonical deck has no native chart objects. Duplicate the selected physical slide and replace only supported text or images. Geometry changes require explicit approval and independent verification.
dataviz.construction: bars=rounded rects (height ∝ value); lines=straight connectors; area=freeform fill; pie=PIE preset with avLst start/end angles; matrix=grid of tinted number cells; timeline=connector track + icon dots. Brand yellow primary; accents cycle blue/olive/orange for multi-series.

templates.slide_96_data_table: table (<=12 cols x <=14 rows); header dark, cream banding

dataviz.overflow_rules: Counts are validated and raise SlotError rather than overcrowd. Charts hold limited categories/rows (e.g. bars <=8, matrix <=8x10); beyond that, simplify, split across slides, or choose a different data-viz template. Pass pre-formatted value strings to keep numeric formatting consistent.
dataviz.qa: verify_templates.check_dataviz_qa() confirms each chart renders from shapes (not a native chart), draws the expected minimum shape count (no dropped bars/rows/slices), and preserves the chart area / layout.

cover.purpose: Deck cover. Large title, optional eyebrow + presenter line, dark or yellow canvas.
